purpose: Required secure task-gate decisions, independent of actual results

01_template.reason: Unsigned supplied example must be rejected.

02_legal_modify.reason: A clean committed modification of the exact granted path is permitted.

03_legal_create_delete.reason: Exact granted create/delete operations are permitted.

04_outside_untracked.reason: An untracked file outside the grant must be rejected.

05_expected_tamper.reason: A committed neutral expected-result fixture under a protected root must be rejected.

06_protected_grant.reason: A grant conflicting with a protected root must be rejected.

07_wrong_branch.reason: The current branch must exactly match the task lock.

08_dirty_integration.reason: Integration mode must reject uncommitted work even on a granted path.

09_delete_denied.reason: Modify permission does not authorize deletion.

10_legal_rename.reason: A rename is allowed when source deletion and destination creation are granted.

11_outside_rename.reason: A rename destination outside the grant must be rejected.

13_drive_grant.reason: A Windows drive-qualified grant is invalid.

14_bad_protected_pattern.reason: A protected pattern containing parent traversal must fail validation.

15_transient_outside_history.reason: A forbidden intermediate commit must not be accepted merely because the cumulative diff is empty.

16_masked_stage_basic.reason: A forbidden staged change hidden by its working-tree counterpart must not pass a complete gate.

17_masked_stage_integration.reason: Require-clean must detect the staged/working-tree masking.

18_ignored_outside.reason: A complete filesystem write gate would reject out-of-scope ignored writes.

19_metadata_exclude.reason: An agent must not evade the write scope by editing Git ignore metadata.

20_protected_case.reason: On Windows a case variant of a protected root must remain protected.

21_case_rename.reason: A case-fold collision is conservatively rejected by this Windows gate.

22_symbolic_parent.reason: An actual filesystem symlink parent must be rejected when the platform can create one.

23_index_symlink_plain_checkout.reason: A committed symlink must be rejected even if Windows materializes it as a regular file.

24_windows_junction.reason: A Windows junction parent must not permit writes to escape the granted directory.

25_self_signed_lock.reason: An agent-created lock claiming controller signature must not authorize a protected fixture write.

26_frozen_tip.reason: A tip differing from the explicitly frozen commit must be rejected.

27_merged_history.reason: Worker history containing a merge must be rejected.

28_detached_head.reason: A detached worker HEAD must be rejected.

29_read_not_enforced.reason: A complete read ACL would prevent an ungranted fixture read; a patch checker cannot do so.

30_skip_worktree_bit.reason: An out-of-scope tracked edit hidden with skip-worktree must not pass integration.

31_assume_unchanged_bit.reason: An out-of-scope tracked edit hidden with assume-unchanged must not pass integration.

scope: Only self-created neutral fixtures inside F02; no production reads/writes beyond allowed control inputs and Git metadata.
